scan_scope: Existing Oresund region: current EMODnet grid, OSM land mask/coastlines, and all generated terrain chunks

depth_holes.estimate_method: Minimum of up to four nearest valid water cells with a water-only line of sight; subtract 1 m inland or 2 m in the coastal buffer; gaps over 12 m neighbor spread stay unknown

shoreline_gaps.source_land_mask: Exact coastline boundary reconstructed from the OSM land mesh used by build_terrain.py; crop edges excluded

limitations: Estimated depths are gameplay-only, conservative interpolation from nearby water cells, and not navigation-grade.
Terrain openings not matched to the source land-mask boundary within 0.05 m are left untouched; they are likely crop boundaries or data holes and require separate review.
The static coast transition closes the matched terrain/OSM shoreline gap visually; it does not add vessel collision.
